_doc: Runtime state the real BIOS fills in at boot (not stored in the image). Values are keyed by varstore name -> byte offset. 'varstore_defaults' applies one value to every question in a varstore; 'values' overrides single offsets. Calibrated against the overview video (Core Ultra 9 285K, 2x24GB Kingston DDR5 XMP 8200, admin access).

system.memory: 2x24GB Kingston DDR5 (XMP 8200 MT/s), slots DDR5_A2 + DDR5_B2

_values_doc: ProcMitAttrib+0/+1 = P/E-core count. MemMitAttrib +1 = kit has a profile, +9 = XMP+EXPO kit, +10 = EXPO kit, +11 = XMP kit, +3..+7 = XMP profile 1..5 absent (decoded from the firmware's own conditions). The emulator overrides these from the selected parts.
